LanguageData.SE_MakeMarksmanSerum.label: make marksman serum
LanguageData.SE_MakeMarksmanSerum.description: Produce marksman serum at a serum lab by conditioning twisted meat and bioferrite.
LanguageData.SE_MakeRefinedMarksmanSerum.label: make refined marksman serum
LanguageData.SE_MakeRefinedMarksmanSerum.description: Produce refined marksman serum at a serum lab. An existing marksman dose can be upgraded with additional materials, or the serum can be synthesized from raw ingredients.
LanguageData.SE_MakeAdvancedMarksmanSerum.label: make advanced marksman serum
LanguageData.SE_MakeAdvancedMarksmanSerum.description: Produce advanced marksman serum at a serum lab. A refined or ordinary marksman dose can be upgraded with additional materials, or the serum can be synthesized from raw ingredients.
